heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly clear south, clouds building over northern New York and the St. Lawrence Valley. Lows in the 30s, nearing 40 around Lake Champlain, a few 20s far south. Light and variable wind.

heading: Monday
text: Increasing clouds cover north with the chance of spotty rain showers, partly cloudy south. Highs from the upper 50s north increasing into the mid-60s south.

heading: Monday Night
text: Partly cloudy early, then clearing around midnight. Lows from the upper 20s to low 30s.
